pages.text: The Regulator Upgrade is a new addition in Refined Storage 2 that provides enhanced control over item and fluid flow in your network. It allows machines to maintain specific quantities with improved precision and efficiency, while optimizing power consumption and network performance.

Key features:$(li)Smart quantity control$(li)Improved flow management$(li)Better power efficiency$(li)Enhanced precision$(li)Automatic throttling$(li)Real-time monitoring$(br2)The Regulator Upgrade is particularly useful in machines like Exporters and Constructors, where maintaining specific quantities is crucial.

Usage:$(li)Install in compatible machines$(li)Set desired quantities$(li)Configure threshold values$(li)Monitor power usage$(li)Adjust flow rates as needed$(br2)The upgrade automatically manages resource flow to maintain your specified quantities while optimizing network performance.
